features.title: Test architecture, protocol fixture and acceptance evidence
features.purpose: Verify Hermbot at four boundaries: (1) a pytest regression suite against an isolated PostgreSQL database hermbot_test (plus MinIO) with fakes for Docker, Hermes runtime RPC and providers; (2) a deterministic OpenAI-compatible protocol fixture model that drives real pinned Hermes runtimes via compose.protocol.yaml; (3) owner-authorized live acceptance drivers that use the paid configured model and sometimes real connected accounts, writing manifest/evidence JSON into test-results/; (4) Playwright browser scripts (real or mocked API) that write screenshots and JSON. Read-only audits (scripts/*_audit.py) re-verify saved evidence against current state.

logic.step: scripts/check.py starts postgres+storage, creates hermbot_test if missing, builds hermbot-tools:phase1 from backend/Tools.Dockerfile, runs ruff over backend/plugins/docker/tests/scripts, then pytest -q --junitxml=/app/test-results/backend.xml inside the tools container on hermbot_control with DATABASE_URL rewritten to hermbot_test.
pytest config: testpaths=tests; markers integration/hermes/live declared.

tests/conftest.py session fixture exits unless DATABASE_URL ends with /hermbot_test, runs db.initialize(); per-test autouse fixture truncates tables, reseeds preferences, resets the 3 seed bots/workspace settings and patches worker.settings; make_task factory creates tasks via service.create_task.

Fakes: native.request (runtime adapter RPC), connector_providers.execute, provisioning.supervisor, containers.docker_request/runtime_command, notifications.send/PinnedSession.post, socket/HTTP servers on loopback; real plugin and docker/*.py modules loaded from /app via importlib.

Protocol stack: compose.protocol.yaml adds service model-fixture (uvicorn tests.model_fixture:app :8010 on the three bot networks) and points MODEL_BASE_URL/MODEL_NAME of api, worker and the hermes-* services to it; prompt markers [POC:*] script tool calls.

Acceptance drivers (python -m tests.<driver>) call http://api:8000 with OWNER_TOKEN, submit each request with an Idempotency-Key (often twice to prove dedupe), persist a manifest before mutations, support resumable modes (start/status/continue/verify/cleanup), and verify via API plus direct DB reads (tool_receipts, events, result_acceptances).

Operator-in-the-loop: recovery drivers write test-results/recovery-signal.json and poll for recovery-<name>-done markers created after the operator performs the Docker action; browser phase2-work/phase3-ui-fixes use the same pattern served by scripts/phase3_recovery_driver.py.

Browser checks: Node ESM scripts with playwright 1.56.1, log in via the Owner token form, either drive real flows or intercept /api/v1/* with page.route to inject fixtures, assert no page errors and no horizontal overflow across viewports, write PNG/JSON to /output.

Evidence export/audit: tests/export_evidence.py aggregates durable receipts into execution-evidence.json; scripts/*_audit.py (phase2/3/4, skills_tools, native_tools, work_outcomes, routines_final/integrity) perform read-only re-verification and upstream-source comparisons.
Verifier self-tests: tests/test_phase4_acceptance_evidence.py and tests/test_event_provider_acceptance.py unit-test the acceptance verification helpers so the harness cannot produce false positives.

data.text: Isolated database hermbot_test (same PostgreSQL service, separate DB); conftest truncates ~40 tables and keeps seed bots researcher/writer/reviewer.
MinIO test bucket hermbot-test used by boundary tests; other suites use the default ArtifactStore bucket and delete created objects.
test-results/ holds 344 evidence files (19 JUnit XML, ~150 JSON manifests/reports, screenshots, 7 marker files, 1 lock, 5 ad-hoc .py probes).

decisions.decision: Separate deterministic protocol acceptance from live-model acceptance
decisions.why: Fixture responses verify transport/persistence, never model quality; README says synthetic responses do not count as live acceptance
decisions.alternatives: Only mocks, or only live runs
decisions.tradeoffs: Protocol stack must be run in an isolated workspace with the initial roster

decisions.decision: Every pytest test runs against real PostgreSQL (autouse fixture) rather than SQLite/mocks
decisions.why: Behaviour depends on Postgres locking, CASCADE, advisory locks, jsonb and triggers (e.g. pg_locks checks in test_phase3_native)
decisions.tradeoffs: Suite needs the compose postgres service and runs serially; no pure-unit tier

decisions.decision: Acceptance drivers are resumable, manifest-first and never resubmit lost work
decisions.why: Real model/provider runs are costly and can have external effects; docstrings and asserts insist on verify/continue instead of duplicates
decisions.tradeoffs: Drivers accumulate hard-coded IDs and become single-use records

decisions.decision: Owner/human performs irreversible or privileged actions (approvals of real writes, Docker restarts, OS push permission, secure input)
decisions.why: Agent-run tests must not approve external effects or grant browser permissions

decisions.decision: Use container paths (/app, /opt/hermes, /output) in tests and drivers
decisions.why: Tests run in hermbot-tools/hermbot-hermes images with the repo mounted at /app
decisions.tradeoffs: Cannot run suite on host without the same mount layout
